video_title: Toronto Raptors Full Media Availability | Post Game at Milwaukee Bucks | November 23, 2026

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on the Raptors' transition offense and rebounding struggles
quotes.excerpt: we got 13 points in transition in the first half and second half we slowed down
quotes.quote: We got 13 points in transition in the first half and second half we slowed down. I thought in the first half I believe we had 11 turnovers. We scored a lot running in transition and in the second half we had only six to that. So that's part of the problem there. And then the rebounding piece there, they were aggressive, they got seven offensive boards there that stopped us, but also it's really hard to run in transition when they're scoring over and over. When you're getting the ball out of the net, it's going to be really hard.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the Raptors transition struggles against Milwaukee: It is really hard to run in transition when they are scoring over and over. When you are getting the ball out of the net it is going to be really hard.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic discusses the team's struggles with transition offense and rebounding against the Bucks.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on the team's defensive adjustments against Tyler Herro
quotes.excerpt: Tyler Herro caught fire in the third quarter there and we tried everything we tried to blitz him
quotes.quote: In the third quarter Tyler Herro caught fire there. We kept him to only three points in the first half. He caught fire in the third quarter there and we tried everything. We tried to blitz him, we tried to switch, we tried to hit in different situations. He played an outstanding game in the second half.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on trying to contain Tyler Herro: We tried everything. We tried to blitz him, we tried to switch, we tried to hit in different situations. He played an outstanding game in the second half.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on the Bucks' talent and the Raptors' learning process
quotes.excerpt: they are a good team. Tyler Herro just scored 50 points the other night
quotes.quote: They are a good team. I think they are a good team. Tyler Herro just scored 50 points the other night. They lost on the last possession against Philly. They play like an NBA team and they have talent on their team as well. Last game we had Dalen Terry who had 20 points and 10 rebounds. I don't expect from a rookie to provide that stat line every single night. So we had a foul problem with Jakob. We had to keep Jakob off the floor in very important moments of the game there. I think this team, the way we are right now, I think we're learning, we're getting better, we're improving, but we're not still consistent.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the Raptors current state: I think this team, the way we are right now, I think we are learning, we are getting better, we are improving, but we are not still consistent.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic evaluates the Bucks' talent and discusses the team's ongoing learning process and consistency issues.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on Immanuel Quickley's recent rhythm and health issues
quotes.excerpt: he played in really good rhythm before this problem with headache that he had for couple of days
quotes.quote: He played in really good rhythm before this problem with headache that he had for couple of days that got him off the court for a couple of days of not playing and working out. So he was struggling a little bit in the game tonight to find that rhythm and to fight through it. Situations that he usually is converting and finishing in the rim, he missed two dunks tonight that does not happen to him. So that was kind of leading to a little bit of indecisiveness for him.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says Immanuel Quickley has been dealing with a headache issue that kept him off the court for a few days, which led to some indecisiveness and missed dunks tonight.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic explains that Immanuel Quickley struggled to find his rhythm after missing time due to headaches.
